title: Three visually similar collectible 'horn' items (a moss-cased hunting horn, a bent bronze calling-horn, and the quest-required huntsman's horn) are carried at once by the end of Kingswood, with near-identical flavor text ('worth the climb; nothing more is owed on it' / 'a grave-good; nothing more is owed for it'). Only the third, given later by Sabel, actually completes the Kingswood recall; nothing distinguishes the two decorative horns from a functional one before that point.
where: Kingswood / Hunt's Stand, sound the recall whole at the horn-post
